deploy-bot: initiating config-only rollout 'minibatch-route-1' in change window 21:00 PST. Diff: routing weight -> minibatch (0.07), max_batch_size 12->8, soft_timeout 2.8s->2.0s, queue_threshold 30->22. Canary: 5% traffic in eu-west-1 for 15m. Rollback triggers: error rate +2.0pp OR p95 token latency >480ms for 5m.

lin: ack. Not touching model artifacts, just policy pin rp-minib-2026-03. Confirm tenant floors/rate caps unchanged?

carla: confirmed tenant caps unchanged. Note: lowering batch size may increase request-per-second cost; monitoring cost signals as well. I'll monitor p95, error-rate, and per-tenant througput.

infra-bot: dashboards provisioned at https://grafana.redwood/d/rollouts/minibatch. Alerts: minibatch-canary-err (2% 5m) and minibatch-canary-p95 (480ms 5m) posted to #oncall.

oncall: oncall here, watching 25% ramp window. Quick rollback CLI ready: `redwoodctl routing rollback --policy rp-minib-2026-03`

deploy-bot: Canary 15m done: error +0.3pp (0.7->1.0), p95 +15ms, queue depth stable. No alerts. Advancing to 25% for 30m.

lin: staying on watch for the 25% window. If kv-cache-miss rises >1pp or queue depth >20 for 10m call for rollback.

carla: noted. Draft release note: "Routing: add minibatch policy to reduce tail latency for short prompts by lowering max_batch_size and tightening soft timeout." Will publish after full ramp.

(End of thread)
